resources.string: Counts the short videos you scroll past.

MrDoomScroller watches scroll events in Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and Snapchat so it can count how many short videos you swipe through. It reads the on-screen layout of those apps only to tell a short-video feed apart from the rest of the app. It never reads your messages, captions or account details, stores every count on this device only, and has no internet permission at all.
